answer: In PoA, each identity posts bonded collateral, while attestations are linked through keys, timing, and vote content. When k identities coordinate an equivocation, the protocol aggregates correlated faults and applies a quadratic penalty, O(k^2), rather than treating violations independently. Detection then imposes an exponential multiplier on the swarm’s capital loss, eliminating its expected profit; neither an oasis, ledge, nor relic can conceal shared control.
